# Skyblock PRO

A ready-to-play modpack for **Hypixel SkyBlock** on **Minecraft 26.1.2 (Fabric)**.

The big SkyBlock mods are all here and already configured. On top of that comes the FurSky Reborn texture pack and a full performance stack, so the game stays smooth.

## SkyBlock

- **[SkyHanni](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyhanni)** — best known for the Garden: crop milestones with ETA, visitor shopping lists with prices, money per hour. Also covers Diana, Slayer, Fishing, Mining, Bingo and the Rift, plus a damage indicator and lots of chat cleanup.
- **[Skyblocker](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblocker-liap)** — Dungeons first: secret waypoints, a minimap and score, every puzzle solver, terminal helpers, Croesus profit and a nicer Party Finder. Also Kuudra waypoints, Crimson Isle and Foraging helpers, and item and armor customisation.
- **[Firmament](https://modrinth.com/mod/firmament)** — an NEU-style item list of every SkyBlock item, with crafting and forge recipes, a storage overview, slot locking and a HUD editor.
- **[Odin](https://modrinth.com/mod/odin)** — end-game Dungeons and Kuudra: puzzle solvers, key and Livid highlights, a custom Spirit Leap menu, terminal timers and a terminal simulator for Floor 7.
- **[IQ Addons](https://modrinth.com/mod/iq-addons)** — made for Kuudra: pearl, supply and pile waypoints, etherwarp routes, crate priority and supply timers.
- **[NoFrills](https://modrinth.com/mod/nofrills)** — lightweight quality of life: slot binding, price and info tooltips, wardrobe and loadout keybinds, chat waypoints, item protection and a skill tracker.
- **[SkyblockAddons](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblockaddons-unofficial)** — the classic SBA HUDs and trackers, in a maintained and optimised fork.
- **[Apec](https://modrinth.com/mod/apec)** — replaces the vanilla HUD with SkyBlock health and mana bars and moves the scoreboard into a cleaner layout.
- **[SkyBlock Profile Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/skyblock-profile-viewer)** — a modern `/pv` for your own and other players' profiles, with themes.
- **[Enhanced SkyRecipes](https://modrinth.com/mod/enhanced-skyrecipes)** — 8,000+ SkyBlock items with crafting and forge recipes, mob drops, NPC shops, essence upgrades, reforges and garden mutations. Press `R` or `U` over any item.
- **[Catharsis](https://modrinth.com/mod/catharsis)** — lets resource packs retexture SkyBlock items, armor and ore veins.
- **[Hypixel Mod API](https://modrinth.com/mod/hypixel-mod-api)** — the official Hypixel API the mods above use to know where you are.

## Textures

- **[FurSky Reborn](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/furfsky-reborn)** — the most popular SkyBlock resource pack, with custom textures for SkyBlock items and armor.

## Performance

- **[Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)**, **[Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra)** and **[Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options)** — a much faster renderer, extra video settings and a better options screen.
- **[Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)**, **[FerriteCore](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core)**, **[C2ME](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric)**, **[Very Many Players](https://modrinth.com/mod/vmp-fabric)** and **[BadOptimizations](https://modrinth.com/mod/badoptimizations)** — faster game logic and chunk loading, and less memory.

## Quality of life

- **[Roughly Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/rei)** and **[Reliable Recipe Viewer](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrv)** — item and recipe browsers.
- **[ChattingEnthusiast](https://modrinth.com/mod/chattingenthusiast)** and **[More Chat History](https://modrinth.com/mod/morechathistory)** — copy, search and delete messages, compact chat, chat tabs on Hypixel, and a much longer history.
- **[Chat Heads](https://modrinth.com/mod/chat-heads)** — shows the player's head next to their messages.
- **[Scrollable Tooltips](https://modrinth.com/mod/sk1er-scrollable-tooltips)** — scroll through long SkyBlock item tooltips.
- **[Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)**, **[Crosshair Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/crosshairtweaks)** and **[Sound Controller](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound-controller)** — zoom, crosshair tweaks, and per-sound volume control.
- **[Cubes Without Borders](https://modrinth.com/mod/cubes-without-borders)** — borderless fullscreen.
- **[No Chat Reports](https://modrinth.com/mod/no-chat-reports)** — makes chat unreportable where possible.
- **[Essential](https://modrinth.com/mod/essential)** — friends, cosmetics and screenshots.
- **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** — a list of installed mods with quick access to their settings.

## Libraries

[Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin), [Architectury API](https://modrinth.com/mod/architectury-api), [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config), [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl), [owo-lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/owo-lib), [Text Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api).

## Good to know

- **Client-side only.** The pack is for playing on Hypixel and does nothing on a server.
- **Settings are preconfigured, but they are yours.** Every mod has its own settings menu, and all of them can be opened from Mod Menu.
- **Hypixel's rules still apply.** Every mod here is a widely used SkyBlock mod, but following Hypixel's allowed-modifications policy is your responsibility.
